Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human tyrosine-protein kinase JAK1 (CHEMBL2835) in Homo sapiens assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target CHEMBL2835 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
